name: Litsycal
description:
A compact calendar for the GNOME panel, inspired by Itsycal for macOS.

Click the panel badge for a small month calendar with an agenda of your upcoming events, using the calendars GNOME already knows about (GNOME Calendar and Online Accounts such as Google).

- Create, edit, search and delete events right from the panel, including quick-add from a one-liner like "Lunch tomorrow 12pm at Cafe Nero"
- Reminders: dated tasks from your task lists in the agenda, with a checkbox to complete them and an Overdue section
- One-click join buttons and an optional countdown for video meetings
- A countdown timer in the panel, with an alarm when time is up
- Live world clocks with the offset from your home time zone
- Week numbers, pinning, Itsycal-style keyboard shortcuts and plenty of appearance options

Clipboard: an agenda event's right-click menu has a "Copy" action that copies the event's details, and a "Copy Meeting Link" action that copies its video-call link, to the clipboard. Nothing is ever read from the clipboard.
